_experiment_choices.explicit.polyak_rate: 0.0125, as on Acrobot; unspecified for this task
_experiment_choices.implicit.rate: replay_weight_max 1, noise_variance_floor 1, rollout_weight 1, model_weight 1, model_points 256; rate_steps 200 and actor_steps 40 per outer iteration, as the cart-pole reference run's gate_e2e.py --rate-steps 200 --actor-steps 40; all unspecified in the paper
_experiment_choices.implicit.solver.inner_steps: 400; K, the fixed value steps per inner solve, is unspecified in the paper (the paper's cost example uses K_k=200)
_experiment_choices.implicit.solver.policy_draws: 4; draws per state N >= 2, unspecified in the paper
_experiment_choices.implicit.solver.resolvent_step: 1 s; the paper's table says to be set
_experiment_choices.network.damping_rank: velocity dimension; unspecified in the paper
_experiment_choices.network.hidden_sizes: (256,256) for actor, value, rate and critics; the paper gives only the plant width
_experiment_choices.protocol.baseline_expectation_samples: 1; the existing CT-SAC update supports only one
_experiment_choices.protocol.deterministic_evaluation: true; the paper's evaluation holds the mean decision
_experiment_choices.protocol.evaluation_reset_seeds: 32 seeds from 20000, as the other tasks
_experiment_choices.temperature: tuned from alpha_c=0.1 per second (the saved runs' 1e-3 per decision at a 10 ms mean), as every reference run; target entropy -3, -1 per decision dimension of the normalized [-1,1] box over which the actor's density is taken (common.ph_config.decision_box_entropy_target), as the saved runs' -3 in the [-1,1] box. The CT-SAC baseline keeps its own target in its action units
_experiment_choices.testbed: dm_control's cartpole swing-up (../ct-rl/.venv dm_control/suite/cartpole.py swingup), as in ../ct-rl's CT-SAC cartpole-swingup runs; not in the paper
_experiment_choices.testbed.clock: fixed 10 ms decisions, dm_control's control step; 1 ms RK4 physics as on Acrobot
_experiment_choices.testbed.controller: offsets from the cart position in [-1, 1] m, stiffness 0-100 N/m, damping 0-20 N s/m, force clipped to +-10 N: Acrobot's decision box, so the two share a decision density
_experiment_choices.testbed.discount_rate: 0.5 per second, as on Acrobot, the other swing-up task; dm_control and the paper do not set one
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.failure_limits: none (empty) since 2026-11-10: the slider keeps dm_control's soft rail limit (plant_parameters cart_range, limit_*), so a cart past 1.8 m is pushed back by MuJoCo's constraint and the episode continues, as in dm_control; there is no failure set, failure payoff or boundary lift (H = 0, B = 1). Every run before 2026-11-10 removed the limit and failed at |x| = 1.8 m (payoff 0, lift B = 1 - (x/1.8)^2); those runs are on the old convention
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.plant_parameters: dm_control's compiled cartpole.xml: cart 1 kg, pole 0.1 kg capsule from 0 to 1 m with its centre of mass at 0.5 m and inertia 0.009424592767295598 kg m^2 about it (dm_control's compiled value; the reference runs used the rounded 0.00942459, a 3e-7 relative difference), slider damping 5e-4, hinge damping 2e-6, g 9.81; the motor is in newtons (dm_control: gear 10 on controls in [-1, 1]). The rail (since 2026-11-10): the slider limited to +-cart_range = 1.8 m with dm_control's solreflimit 0.08 1 (limit_timeconst, limit_dampratio) and MuJoCo's default solimplimit 0.9 0.95 0.001 0.5 2 (limit_d0, limit_dmax, limit_width, limit_midpoint, limit_power), which dm_control's XML leaves at the default; the compiled jnt_range, jnt_solref and jnt_solimp equal dm_control's
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.reset_parameters: dm_control's swing-up start: x ~ N(0, 0.01^2), theta ~ pi + N(0, 0.01^2), both rates ~ N(0, 0.01^2)
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.reward_parameters: dm_control's smooth swing-up reward as a rate in [0, 1]: upright (1+cos theta)/2, centered (1+g(x/2))/2, small_control (4+1-u^2)/5 with u = force/10, small_velocity (1+g(theta_dot/5))/2, g the gaussian tolerance with 0.1 at the margin. failure_rate 0, never charged: there is no failure set (the rail is dm_control's soft limit)
_experiment_choices.training.validation_fraction: 0.05; f_val is unspecified in the paper. Under plant_update always these held-out rows are never read, as in the reference runs; the gated arms score them
_experiment_choices.training.plant_step_schedule: plant_step_dense_until 100000, plant_step_every 4 (proposed 2026-11-10, CONFIRMED 2026-11-11 after the exclude_thin experiment, Vista job 1135664: no measurable change in plant error or score from 100k to 200k decisions on cartpole-swingup, point_mass-easy and lqr_6_2, about a third less time per decision; benchmarks/make_ct_ph_sac_table.PLANT_STEP_SCHEDULE, which every dm_control row carries and which this file must equal): the learned plant takes its online step on every row until 100k decisions, then on every 4th row. The plant step is 63-70% of an implicit decision's time; learned plants are ~6% off right after the warm fit and reach 0.2-0.3% drift error by ~100k decisions, then stay flat. Removing both keys restores a step on every row (the default, every run before 2026-11-10)
_experiment_choices.implicit.reward_source: learned: a reward-rate network fitted to observed rows, read through a copy frozen with each outer iteration's operator, as the cart-pole reference run (learned_reward.py)
_experiment_choices.implicit.reward_warm_steps: 2000 reward steps on replay batches once warm-up fills a batch, before the first value step; as learned_reward.py
_experiment_choices.implicit.plant_warm_steps: 2000 online-plant steps on replay batches once warm-up fills a batch, then admitted untested before the first value solve; the reference runs' gate_e2e.py --warm-fit 2000
_experiment_choices.implicit.plant_fit_covariance: leading_order, as the reference runs' gate_e2e.py --cov leading_order; with network.diffusion none the covariance is zero either way
_experiment_choices.implicit.temperature_every_rows: 40: one tuning step of log alpha_c per 40 collected rows, taken in a burst at each outer iteration's end; the reference runs' gate_e2e.py --temperature-every 40. The explicit arms tune once per interaction
_experiment_choices.implicit.admission.plant_update: always: the online plant is copied into the admitted plant untested at every cycle end, every M=ceil(3/log(1+lambda tau))=8 outer iterations; the transfer score J is recorded and decides nothing. The reference runs' gate_e2e.py --arm always. The staged-gate settings below apply only to the implicit_gated_admissions and implicit_fixed_gate_allocation arms
_experiment_choices.network.diffusion: none: a drift-only plant with the drift loss 0.5*|e|^2/Delta, as both cart-pole reference runs (no_diffusion.py, no_diffusion_explicit.py)
_experiment_choices.reference_differences: Against the reference runs of docs/implementation_report Appendix A (config cartpole_tuned): the rail is dm_control's soft limit (since 2026-11-10) where the reference failed at |x| = 1.8 m, and the learned plant is kept off the rail by contact exclusion (contact_handling exclude, since 2026-11-11; the limit port of 2026-11-10 to 11-11 is gone); with no failure set no value head carries a boundary lift (B = 1). The implicit settings are the reference's: learned reward, drift-only plant, warm fit, untested admissions, 200/40 rate-head/actor steps
_experiment_choices.contact_handling: exclude (since 2026-11-11; benchmarks/make_ct_ph_sac_table.CONTACT_HANDLING, which this file must equal, sets it on the six cart-pole rows and point_mass-easy; common.ph_config.CONTACT_HANDLINGS): contact exclusion in place of the limit port. The learned plant is the free mechanism (network.limit_port absent, false); a replay transition whose start state lies within the reach margin of the rail (1% of its range plus the damped travel bound over the interval, rule version 2) or whose interval touched the rail is left out of the plant fit (warm fit included), every use of the plant at such a state falls back to the observed transition (model-free targets), model paths are truncated at their last knot clear of the rail, and every model integration runs at model_coarse_step (5 ms) with no fine re-integration. Decided after the experiment of 2026-11-10 (Vista job 1135664, implicit, 3 seeds, 200k decisions): the same final score as the port (8.5-8.6 against 8.65), 94 against 275 ms per decision, plant error on free intervals 0.2% against 0.9%. Known compromise: the value at flagged states is trained from logged decisions (off-policy). benchmarks/run_ph_sac.py --contact-handling port restores the port (network.limit_port true, contact-triggered fine substepping)
_experiment_choices.network.limit_port: absent (false) since 2026-11-11, under contact_handling exclude (above); from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-11 true: the learned plant adds, beyond the rail's known range +-1.8 m (the state spec's limited_position_ranges), a one-sided spring and damper with learned stiffness, damping and ramp width, exactly zero inside, for the soft rail limit's kink (models/ph_sac/plant.py); every dm_control row with a kept joint limit sets it (cart-poles, reacher, point mass, swimmers). The port starts at the compiled limit (the factory's state spec limit_port_init, environment/ph_sac/dmc/joint_limits.limit_port_init): stiffness 1/(dof_invweight0 tc^2 dampratio^2) = 160.5 N/m, damping 2/(dof_invweight0 tc) = 25.7 N s/m, width 1.053e-3 m (the 1e-3 floor plus solimp width times 1 - d0/dmax), with tc 0.08 s and dof_invweight0 0.973 /kg; the plant's generic start (1e-2, 1e-3, 0.1) left the port inert at the 3e-4 learning rate
_experiment_choices.model_integrator: rk4, the repository default since 2026-11-09: every model integration of the plant (the plant fit's endpoint mean, the explicit rollout target, the rate head's rollouts, the gate paths) advances each substep of model_step by classical RK4 of the drift, the controller's feedback law evaluated at each of the four stages from that stage's state (testbed.controller.refresh_mode continuous). That is this testbed's simulator step (MuJoCo RK4 at the 1 ms physics step, the law evaluated at every stage by MuJoCo's control callback), so at this config's model_step of 1 ms the true drift reproduces the simulator's endpoints and is the optimum of the plant fit (see model_step). Runs before 2026-11-09 used semi_implicit, the velocity-first semi-implicit Euler step; the closed loop here is not stiff (h c_max / m_eff at most 0.02, against 2 on the reacher's wrist)
_experiment_choices.testbed.controller.refresh_mode: continuous, the factory's (the table's task_refresh_mode): the impedance law turns the state into a torque at every RK4 stage, in the environment through MuJoCo's control callback and in the model's RK4 stages, as a continuous-time controller would, so a model_step above the 1 ms physics step integrates the same closed loop. Every run before 2026-11-09 held the torque through each 1 ms physics step and its stages; the top-level key refresh_mode held (or benchmarks/run_ph_sac.py --refresh-mode held) reproduces them bitwise
_experiment_choices.model_coarse_step: 0.005 s (since 2026-11-10; common.ph_config.MODEL_COARSE_STEPS, which this file must equal). Under contact_handling exclude (this file since 2026-11-11) it is the step of every model integration, with no fine re-integration (common.ph_config.exclusion_model_step); what follows applies with the limit port (contact_handling port): contact-triggered fine substepping. Every model integration of an interval (plant fit, rollout targets, rate-head rollouts, gate paths, path Jacobian norms) first integrates every row at 5 ms, two substeps, the free-state bound of the cart-poles (p99 one-interval relative endpoint error 5.0e-4 at 5 ms, 1.7e-3 at 10 ms, 2026-11-09); a row whose coarse path comes, at any knot, within the margin 0.01 x 3.6 m + 2 x 5 ms x |cart speed| of the rail (or past it) is integrated again over the whole interval at the 1 ms model step, the only step accurate through the rail's soft limit, and that result replaces the coarse one (models/ph_sac/rollouts.contact_flags). Absent or null: every row at 1 ms, as every run before
_experiment_choices.model_step: 0.001 s, the physics step, ten substeps per 10 ms decision (common.ph_config.MODEL_STEPS; since 2026-11-10 again): the model step is coarsened only on tasks without joint limits, and the slider keeps dm_control's soft rail limit. With the limit in the oracle, an interval that touches the rail stays within the 1e-3 relative endpoint error only at 1 ms (p99 about 2e-15 at 1 ms, 0.65 at 2 ms, 1.6 at 5 ms on rows started at the rail, 2026-11-10): the limit's damping switches on with a jump (impedance 0.9 at zero penetration) that a longer RK4 step straddles, and in short training runs 48% of intervals ended pressed on the rail. Without the rail the uniform-box criterion had allowed 5 ms (7.2e-5 at 2 ms, 5.0e-4 at 5 ms, 1.7e-3 at 10 ms; 2026-11-09), the value of this config on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10; at 1 ms the true drift reproduces the simulator's endpoints to rounding
